title: Figure 52: real acoustic pressure vs radial distance, 10,000 Hz radiating sphere
description: ANSYS 12.1 line graph of steady-state real component of pressure (Pa) versus radial distance (m) for 10,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water. Very rapid decaying oscillation, uniformly radiating sphere EPW=25, ANSYS versus theory. BAASS underwater acoustics validation.
